updatedItems.title: [P2] Search across multiple local PDF documents

screenshot.reason: The browser screenshot API supports image preview but exposes no authorized local-file export; saved proof uses exact server-reloaded descriptions and visible DOM row/filter readback.

projects.notes: Edited the two existing draft descriptions under lmdanavanem and set Done after public package and updater verification. Original criteria retained. No issues or conversation comments created; other item statuses and the three saved filters retained.

limits: Saved files only; explicit sequential physical-page alignment, no automatic OCR or semantic/word diff.
768-pixel long side, RGB tolerance 16/255; no observed difference does not establish PDF identity or hidden-data/signature/conformance properties.
64 files maximum for search, 64 MiB/file, 250000 PDFium characters/page; search 10000 pages/2000 matching pages, comparison 1-500 pairs/default 200.
Cancellation between native page operations is not an interrupt or native memory/CPU ceiling for hostile PDFs.
No independent update publication key is available; GitHub HTTPS and same-channel SHA256 remain the distribution boundary.
Windows packages are unsigned; ARM64 hardware, Narrator, physical printers/GPU, manual GUI/updater and third-party interoperability remain separate qualification.
No PDF/A/PDF/UA or archival LTV certification.
delivery: Owner-authorized direct pushes used the existing branch/tag-rule bypass. No rules were changed. Draft-only tags were corrected after new test failures; no release/assets were public at those adjustments. Main and tag CI qualify the final immutable published source.
